human_direction.name: Ahimanikya Satapathy
human_direction.scope: Three flexible illustrated visit plans, saved journeys and portable books.

changes: Three plans connect two cultural stops with a food pause, with shorter alternatives and local preparation questions.
Each starter creates a separate three-item unscheduled journey; older trails and journeys remain intact.
Story links, contribution context, coastal edition inclusion and credited book chapters use existing infrastructure.
Shared trail headings now retain a space before their highlighted words.
media_approach: Existing documentary photographs only. No new AI imagery or external research.

browser.result: Desktop and mobile reading layouts reviewed. Mobile page widths fit 390px. Bhubaneswar starter created three unscheduled ideas in a separate journey.

exports.automated: All three plans retain selected chapters, preparation and image credits; shortened selections remove the matching chapter. Personal-note exclusion and backup round trips pass.
exports.result: Downloaded file contains all three story chapters and creator credit; personal notes omitted through the UI.

limitations: Current openings, hosts, costs, capacity, access and transfers require local confirmation. No timed route or booking is promised.
No new fieldwork or independent local review. Existing source evidence and documentary photographs reused.
Bhubaneswar and Puri meal chapters use labelled setting photographs, not photographs of the dish or a recommended restaurant.
Native PDF layout was not re-tested in this batch; HTML and text book exports were checked.
Founder publication approval remains pending; existing search approval scope is unchanged.
operational_follow_up: POD-WORK-171 retains its provider-confirmed costs, timings and capacity acceptance criteria; these editorial plans are a reusable starting point, not completion of that field-dependent work.
